tasks.description: Extend backend state layer (backend/state.py) with the document ingestion pipeline: validate PDF readability, load and split the document, build the FAISS vectorstore, rebuild the QA chain, update loaded_files, and persist index/history so restore() still works

Add POST /api/upload FastAPI endpoint that accepts one or more PDF uploads, invokes the state-layer ingestion pipeline, and returns loaded status and file list; return proper error responses for unreadable PDFs

Add POST /api/ask endpoint: answer a question via the QA chain using current chat history, append the exchange to history (with persistence), record last retrieval query and source snippets as debug info, and return the answer; 4xx when no document is loaded
Add chat history endpoints: GET /api/history to return the chat history and DELETE /api/history to clear it (including persisted history file)
Add GET /api/debug endpoint returning the most recent retrieval debug info (query and source snippets recorded by /api/ask)

Disconnect Streamlit: delete app.py and the ui/ package, remove streamlit dependencies from pyproject.toml (run uv sync), and update README/CLAUDE.md run instructions to launch the FastAPI backend instead
